title: ggchord 设计路线图
text: 本文档记录 ggchord 的实际实现状态、已确认的问题、目标 API 以及版本计划。 状态以当前代码为准，不再把“已有设计”标记成“已经完成”。 当前正式版本为 v0.9.0，代码库版本为 v0.10.0 开发版。 以正确性和 ggplot2 语法一致性为中心的基础重构已于 2026-08-31 随 v0.9.0 发布；v0.10.0 在用户确认前不创建正式标签或 Release。 总体优先级： 正确性与可重复性； ggplot2 风格的公开接口； 绘图表现力； 导出、性能和生态稳定性。

previous_headings: 二、设计原则
title: ggchord 设计路线图
text: 遵循 ggplot2 的基本分工： aes() 决定数据列映射到什么视觉属性； scale_*() 决定映射后的取值、范围、变换、breaks、labels 和 guide； geom_*() 决定几何形状、固定样式和局部布局； coord_chord() 决定全局旋转、比例、坐标范围、裁切和自动适配； theme_*() 决定非数据元素的外观； guide_*() 决定图例的排列和绘制方式。 固定颜色或透明度仍可写在 geom 中。例如 geom_ribbon(fill = "red") 是固定 样式，不属于 scale。只有由数据映射而来的颜色、透明度、线型和图例配置必须 进入 scale_*()。

previous_headings: 二、设计原则
title: ggchord 设计路线图
text: 每个 ggchord 图层必须拥有独立的 layer_id、data、mapping 和参数。 同一张图应支持多个 region、feature、gene、highlight 或 label 图层，后添加的 图层不得覆盖前一图层的数据和样式。

previous_headings: 二、设计原则
title: ggchord 设计路线图
text: 不添加自定义 scale、theme 或 coord 时，默认绘图效果应尽量保持不变。接口迁移 可以改变参数归属，但不应无理由改变默认配色、布局和标签位置。

previous_headings: 三、v0.9.0 实现审计 > 3.1 核心构建流程
title: ggchord 设计路线图
text: compute_chord_geometry() 每种图层只保存一份参数，多个同类图层由最后一个 覆盖。两个 geom_seq_region() 最终会绘制完全相同的最后一组 region。 多数 geom 虽然声明了 mapping 和 data，但实际使用固定占位数据和固定 mapping，用户输入被忽略。 ggplot_build.ggchord() 会重建所有图层、插入 scale 并覆盖 coordinate，导致 标准 ggplot2 扩展行为受到限制。 get_chord_layout() 返回包环境里“最近一次构建”的布局，多图交错构建时含义 不明确。 ggchord() 重复执行基础验证和 validate_ggchord_data()，验证规则存在两个来源。

title: ggchord：基于 ggplot2 的多序列弦图可视化工具
text: ggchord 是一个基于 ggplot2 的 R 语言包，采用分层的图形语法将多序列数据绘制为直观的弦图。与“一个大函数”不同，你通过叠加图层来构建图形：ggchord() 负责提供数据与全局选项，每个 geom_* 图层负责绘制一类元素（序列弧线、比对连接带、基因注释、坐标轴、标签）。每个图层都有合理的默认值，因此一行代码即可画出完整的弦图，需要精细控制时也可以分别微调每个图层。 该包是通用的多序列比较工具，可用于序列比较、基因邻域分析、噬菌体-宿主关系、泛基因组区块、共线性分析等——你只需要准备三张规整的数据表。

title: ggchord：基于 ggplot2 的多序列弦图可视化工具
text: 真正的 ggplot2 分层风格：数据与全局选项交给 ggchord()，每个 geom_* 图层管理自己的布局参数。 开箱即用：ggchord(data) + geom_seq() + geom_ribbon() + geom_gene() + geom_axis() 即可得到完整图形。 多序列支持：可同时展示两条、三条、四条或更多序列。 灵活的参数：支持单值、向量、命名向量与列表，可按序列或链方向分别设置。 与 ggplot2 生态无缝衔接：theme()、scale_*()、ggsave()、ggplot_build() 均可使用。 三种确定性基因标签布局：规则对齐轨道、紧凑局部径向轨道和沿弧线切线放置的标签。

title: ggchord 汉语使用指南
text: geom_gene_label_repel() 提供三种确定性模式。默认 "aligned" 将水平文字 排成规则的行和垂直列；"radial" 保持文字水平，并沿真实序列曲线选择最近的 无冲突平行轨道；"arc" 沿局部切线旋转文字、自动翻转倒置文字，并且只在 标签离开第一轨道后绘制短指示线。 三种模式都会使用实际的 seq_radius、seq_curvature、seq_gap、 seq_orientation、旋转和局部曲线几何。局部外侧/内侧标签理念借鉴了 SnapGene 与 Geneious，但 ggchord 使用通用模式名和独立实现。如需手工旋转或偏移，请使用 geom_gene_label()。 geom_gene_label() 也是紧凑的固定标签方案。v0.10.0 默认将文字水平放在 弦图外侧，按输入行顺序保留标签并省略后续冲突项。可以用 gene_label_orientation = "radial" 或 "tangent" 改变文字方向，用 gene_label_side = "auto" 或 "inside" 选择侧向，并用 gene_label_overlap = "nudge" 或 "allow" 优先保留全部文字。手工旋转和逐序列/ 逐链偏移仍集中在这一个固定标签图层中，不新增重复的手动 geom。 整体信息层级还借鉴了 Circos、 clinker 的发表级基因箭头， 以及 DNA Features Viewer 的注释冲突处理思路。 这些只是设计原则参考，ggchord 使用独立的配色、几何和通用 API 名称。

Registered axis, sequence-label, gene-label leader-line theme elements resolved standard ggplot2 build; explicit geom style still takes priority. geom_axis() routes shared styles compatible child geoms accepts separate line_params, tick_params text_params. former show_legend argument removed axis annotations never participate legend. geom_seq_group_label() provides independent group-label layer, labels created implicitly geom_seq() remain available compatibility. Group values now train scale_group_colour_manual() instead treating already-resolved colour strings categories. geom_seq_label(labels = ...) separates displayed sequence text scale labels; seq_labels remains deprecated alias. Label arguments passed geom_gene() now fail clearly instead warned leaked geom_polygon(). Geom-level legend positions colourbar dimensions remain functional v0.9.0 direct users guides().

title: ggchord 0.9.0
text: geom_gene_label_repel() now uses deterministic gene_label_layout = "aligned" | "radial" | "arc" interface. "aligned" remains default arranges horizontal labels orderly cardinal rails. "radial" uses nearest collision-free local offset track keeping text horizontal. "arc" rotates readable text along sequence tangent draws short leader label moved away first track. modes now use sequence’s real curve local normal, including custom seq_radius, seq_curvature, seq_gap, mixed seq_orientation, rotation sequence groups. share fixed-obstacle avoidance, cross-sequence collision handling, order-preserving leader routing device-aware clipping. Rotated labels use oriented-rectangle collision clipping, preventing spurious whitespace oversized breaks leaders. layout ideas informed orderly multi-sequence callout figures external/inside feature-label approaches offered SnapGene Geneious. ggchord uses generic mode names implementation; copy third-party assets visual designs. See SnapGene feature-label documentation Geneious label options.

what: New features: improved label placement and de-overlap
title: ggchord 0.8.0
text: geom_seq_label() now places sequence names arc default (seq_label_radius = 1) rotates along arc keeping readable; seq_label_orientation = "horizontal" draws every label horizontally, extending away chord centre. geom_gene_label() now sits right beside gene arrows default (gene_label_radial_offset = 0.04) gains gene_label_wrap wrapping long annotations narrower, less overlapping labels. geom_gene_label_repel() now defaults gene_label_orientation = "horizontal", gene_label_segment = "elbow" (L-shaped leader line adapts label’s position text width) gene_label_side = "outside", labels stay readable ribbon area. deterministic final de-overlap pass measures exact rendered text boxes treats sequence, group axis labels hard rectangular obstacles; max_overlaps hides labels still collide repulsion (ggrepel-style decluttering). label text-box projection now shared repulsion solver, obstacle boxes coordinate limits, three agree text actually drawn.

title: ggchord 0.8.0

title: ggchord 0.8.0
text: geom_seq() gains sequence-grouping support via seq_group, seq_group_gap, seq_group_labels, seq_group_label_radius seq_group_colors. Groups can come seq_group column seq_data supplied single value, named/positional vector, list. extra inter-group gap (seq_group_gap) inserted boundaries different groups, optional group labels drawn angular midpoint group, customisable radius. Group labels rendered horizontally use internal zcolour identity scale, never interfere Seq ID colour legend. geom_seq() stays backward compatible still returns single layer; group labels appended lazily build time.

what: New features: ribbon visual mappings and direction
title: ggchord 0.8.0
text: geom_ribbon() can now map numeric column continuous fill via ribbon_color_by (example "bitscore" instead pident), ribbon_color_limits, ribbon_color_breaks ribbon_color_name control colourbar. ribbon_alpha_by / ribbon_alpha_range scale ribbon transparency continuously numeric column. ribbon_outline_by / ribbon_outline_colors ribbon_linetype_by / ribbon_linetypes map discrete columns outline colour linetype using internal aesthetics, without disturbing Seq ID Identity(%) legends. ribbon_direction (one "none", "alpha", "outline" "linetype") visually distinguishes - vs reverse-orientation alignments, ribbon_direction_colors, ribbon_direction_linetypes ribbon_direction_alpha fine control. legend_key_width / legend_key_height control size Identity(%) colourbar key.

what: New features: highlights and generic features
title: ggchord 0.8.0
text: New geom_seq_region() draws rectangular bands along sequence arcs mark loci, repeats, CRISPR arrays user-defined intervals. accepts seq_id, start end (plus optional label, category color) exposes region_fill, region_color, region_alpha, region_width, region_offset region_side. New geom_ribbon_highlight() emphasizes selected ribbons without changing underlying Identity(%) legend. Selection uses safe, explicit filters (ribbon_ids, query/subject IDs, pident/length ranges, predicate function) reuses computed ribbon geometry. New geom_feature() thin, backwards-compatible convenience layer CDS, tRNA, rRNA, repeat, CRISPR, promoter custom feature tables; prepares gene-compatible table reuses geom_gene()’s geometry scales, feature_colors, feature_width, feature_offset feature_order styling.

what: New features: structured data validation and cleaning
title: ggchord 0.7.0
text: New exported function validate_ggchord_data() returns structured ggchord_validation object: valid flag, errors (severe problems), warnings (drawable noteworthy issues), per-category summary counts, data_summary (sequences/ribbons/genes, unknown IDs, --range rows, …), original row numbers every problem (invalid_rows) automatically fixable issues (cleanable). print() summary() methods provided; strict = TRUE stops severe problems. New exported function clean_ggchord_data() applies explicit, conservative policies (unknown_id, out_of_range, reversed_interval, invalid_pident, empty_annotation) returns cleaned tables plus full report every change (original row number, reason, original/new values, action). input objects never modified nothing dropped silently. ggchord() gains validate = c("warn", "error", "none") argument. default "warn" emits single summary warning (never one warning per row) caches full report plot (p$ggchord$validation); "error" stops severe problems; "none" keeps fast path. Valid input renders exactly .

what: New features: data import and ribbon preparation
title: ggchord 0.7.0
text: read_blast() parses BLAST -outfmt 6/7 tabular output (12 17 columns, auto-detected) ribbon_data format, preserving evalue, bitscore, qcovs, qlen, slen, sstrand stitle present. read_gff3() parses GFF3 files gene_data format, selecting feature_types (default CDS), extracting anno attribute keys (product, Name, …), decoding percent-encoding, mapping unstranded features + (dropping ). read_fasta_lengths() reads FASTA headers sequence lengths seq_data format, optional header_delim splitting. filter_ggchord_ribbons() filters ribbons sequence IDs, pident, length, E-value, bitscore, query/subject coverage, undirected sequence pairs self-links, optional sorting; missing columns produce clear errors. deduplicate_ggchord_ribbons() removes exact, coordinate-near highly overlapping duplicate blocks (= "exact" | "coordinates" | "overlap") keeping best pident, longest, first representative. merge_ggchord_ribbons() merges adjacent/overlapping blocks sequence pair length-weighted pident. Merging deliberately conservative: blocks inconsistent spans, large pident differences different orientations left unmerged. ribbon utilities keep extra columns original column order, attach original row numbers source_rows attribute, return report removed/merged .

title: ggchord 0.6.0
text: Plot objects now fully self-contained: data parameters stored plot instead package-wide environment. Multiple plots can created built independently session, plots survive saveRDS() / readRDS(). layout now computed ggplot_build() rather custom print() method. result print(), ggsave(), ggplot_build() standard ggplot2 workflows work directly ggchord plots, rendering longer modifies user’s plot object. New layer geom_seq_label(): places sequence labels midpoint sequence arc control radial offset (seq_label_radius), rotation (seq_label_rotation) font size (seq_label_size). New ribbon color scheme "subject": colors ribbons subject sequence (saccver), complementing existing "query" scheme. layout accessor get_chord_layout() now exported, making computed geometry available custom layers annotations. Themes, scales ggplot2 objects can now added + (e.g. p + theme(legend.position = "bottom")), user-supplied colour/fill scales respected instead overwritten. ggchord() now warns suspicious input data: reversed --range alignment/gene coordinates, pident outside [0, 100], sequence IDs present seq_data. geom_gene_label_repel() gains gene_label_side = "auto" | "inside" | "outside". "outside", labels sit inside chord (can overlap ribbons) mirrored outside sequence arc, keeping radial distance arc. New gene_label_segment_linetype argument controls leader-line linetype. default "auto" draws solid lines, except labels moved side arc (gene_label_side), drawn dashed. valid ggplot2 linetype (e.g. "dotted" numeric dash pattern) applied leader lines. Elbow leader lines longer force fixed segment lengths: stub scales label’s text width horizontal space available gene label, labels can placed flexibly without degenerate (near-zero) stubs. geom_seq_label() now documents follows intended seq_label_radius semantics: 1 sits arc, > 1 places label outside (away chord center) < 1 inside. Previously multiplier applied opposite direction (default 1.15 put labels inside chord). New geom_seq_label() options: seq_label_orientation = "arc" | "horizontal" (horizontal labels extend away chord center), seq_label_hjust / seq_label_vjust per-sequence justification, check_overlap skip labels overlap. default theme longer draws grid lines (panel.grid blank) legend keys transparent (blend plot background instead fixed white rectangle).

title: ggchord 0.6.0
text: Tests longer write hard-coded /tmp path: use tempfile(), test suite passes Windows leaves stray files behind R CMD check (fixes CRAN incoming-check failure). Identity(%) colourbar longer collapses thin/invisible line legend placed top/bottom legend box horizontal (legend.box = "horizontal"). now follows theme’s legend position: vertical bar filling available height left/right, fixed-size horizontal bar top/bottom. Legend keys transparent inherit panel.background (ggplot2 4.x lets unset legend keys follow panel background, key fill set explicitly stay transparent). Sequence (gene) labels longer end upside global rotation >= 90 used: readability flip now re-applied layout rotation instead . repulsion spring now pulls labels toward starting position rather leader-line anchor, keeps labels moved gene_label_side = "outside" outside leader line still starts gene. gene_label_side, every label kept requested side arc (previously labels moved side switch re-checked, crowded repulsion layout push labels across arc). built-gene_data_example annotations longer contain URL-encoded %2C artifacts (e.g. “ribonucleotide reductase%2C large subunit” now “ribonucleotide reductase large subunit”).

title: ggchord 0.6.0
